description: Fix the issuer validation logic in JWT token handling to properly support different issuer parameter types. Currently, string issuers are incorrectly transformed into character lists, which breaks validation. Update the implementation to correctly handle string, container of strings, and None issuer values as specified by the PyJWT library.
functional_requirements: Modify JWT token validation to accept string issuer values without converting them to character lists
Support container types (like lists or tuples) for multiple allowed issuers as specified in PyJWT documentation
Maintain backward compatibility with None issuer values for cases where issuer validation is disabled
Add comprehensive test coverage for all issuer parameter types (string, list, tuple, None)
Ensure the fix aligns with PyJWT's decode API specification for issuer validation
